<style>
        @import url("https://use.typekit.net/xcu6jyb.css");

        :root {
            --sg-font: "allotrope-variable", sans-serif;
            --sg-font-var: "wght" 100, "wdth" 50;
            --sg-nav-li-var: "wght" 100, "wdth" 60;
            --sg-color-var: "wght" 100, "wdth" 40;
            --sg-body-var: "wght" 150, "wdth" 80;
            --sg-specs-var: "wght" 100, "wdth" 50;
        }

        .sg,
        .sg:hover {
            color: #fff;
            font-family: var(--sg-font);
            font-variation-settings: var(--sg-font-var);
            text-align: center;
            transition: all 500ms ease-in-out 200ms;
            display: none;
        }

        .sg:hover {
            opacity: .5;
            transition: all 500ms ease-in-out 200ms;
        }


        /* ===== COLOR BOXES ===== */
        .palette {
            gap: 2vw;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .palette .color {
            transform-origin: center;
            height: 150px;
            width: 150px;
            text-align: center;
            z-index: 1;
            margin: 2px 2px 20px 2px;
            position: relative;
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow: rgba(149, 157, 165, 0.1) 0px 2pxpx 2px 2px;
            -webkit-animation: slide-in-fwd-center 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.250, 0.460, 0.450, 0.940) both;
            animation: slide-in-fwd-center 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.250, 0.460, 0.450, 0.940) both;
            transition: all 500ms ease-in-out 200ms;
        }

        #primary .color {
            height: 175px;
            width: 175px;

        }

        .palette .color:hover {
            box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.56) 0px 10px 200px 200px;
            transform: scale(1.33);
            border-radius: 2%;
            z-index: 100;
            -webkit-animation: slide-in-fwd-center 1000ms cubic-bezier(0.250, 0.460, 0.450, 0.940) both 200ms;
            animation: slide-in-fwd-center 1000ms cubic-bezier(0.250, 0.460, 0.450, 0.940) both 200ms;
            transition: all 500ms ease-in-out 200ms;
        }

        /* specs */
        .color .spec {
            font-size: 1rem;
            margin: 2px 0;
            transform: translate(0, -50%);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: all 500ms ease-in-out 200ms;
        }

        .color:hover .spec {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translate(0, 0);
        }

        /* color names */
        .color .name {

Footnotes

  1. A dramaturg is a theatre artist who works with the playwright, director, designers, and actors in developing new or existing plays from the perspective of the audience. A dramaturg's least favorite thing is defining dramaturgy.
  2. In botany, a rhizome is an underground system of tangled roots that all connect to each other. In philosophy, rhizomatic theory allows for multiple, non-hierarchical entry and exit points in data representation and interpretation. It was set forth in the book A Thousand Plateaus by Félix Guattari and Gilles Louis René Deleuze.

Anna Jennings

Web Artist, Architect, & Consultant

Anna is a director, dramaturg1, and producer and is obsessed with the mechanics and magic of live performance. Her primary artistic interests lie in spatial theory, immersive performance, and site-specific productions.

She discovered the concept of theatrum mundi in her MFA research in theatrical use of city space in the Edinburgh Fringe Festival and the rhizomaticstructure of arts festivals.

Anna also loves writing, puzzles, photography, and footnotes. You can check out her portfolio here:

Theatre & Web Design

A website is a stage to present a brand's aesthetics, personality, and values as part of the overall experience--but, it goes even deeper than what you see "onstage." The mechanics operating backstage can offer pragmatic solutions to every day business problems.

Theatrum Mundi's approach to web design is an artistic process of holistic creative problem solving.

Subjective experience of your brand drives the front-facing visual design, while your objective business goals inform the behind the scenes structure and functionality.
